name: ring_molecule
description: A skeletal chemistry ring (benzene-style hexagon or 5-ring): optional heteroatoms at vertices, alternating aromatic double bonds, and substituents pointing outward. Choose this scene for requests about aromatic rings, benzene/pyridine/furan-style molecules, functional groups on a ring, or simple 'draw molecule X' requests where X is a substituted ring. Skeletal convention: unlabeled vertices are carbons; bonds trim at labeled atoms. Vertex positions are indexed 0 at the top going counter-clockwise.

atoms.description: Per-vertex atom symbol (index 0 = top). "C" or null = skeletal carbon (no label). E.g. pyridine: [null, null, "N", null, null, null].

element_ids.ring_center: anchor at the ring center (for gestures)

examples.request: Draw phenol with the OH group.
